title: AeternumAcademicSourceManifest
description: Schema for machine-readable Aeternum academic source registration manifests.

source_id.description: Deterministic canonical identifier for the registered academic source.

source_title.description: Official title of the registered bibliographic work.

authors.description: List of primary authors or compiling entity, or null if unstated in original source.

edition.description: Edition designation (e.g. '5a Edición', '1st Edition'), or null if not applicable.

publication_year.description: Year of publication, or null if unknown.

publisher.description: Publishing company or institution, or null if not applicable.

isbn_if_explicitly_available.description: Official ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 identifier if explicitly documented in the artifact, or null.

language.description: Languages supported or used in the source artifact.

source_type.description: Categorical form of the work (e.g. GROSS_ANATOMY_TEXTBOOK, ANATOMICAL_ATLAS, INSTITUTIONAL_TEACHING_NOTES).

authority_class.description: Governing academic authority classification under AACM-1.0 and AKAP-1.0.

artifact_filename.description: Filename of the inspected artifact, or null if reference-only.

artifact_path_or_reference.description: Local filesystem path or repository reference to the artifact.

artifact_sha256.description: Deterministic SHA256 checksum of the local artifact file, or null if artifact unavailable.

page_count.description: Total verified page count of the artifact, or null if not page-addressable.

provenance_type.description: Nature of provenance backing this registration.

authorization_status.description: Legal and governance usage authorization state.

usage_scope.description: Explicit operational scope and transformation rights.

academic_validation_eligible.description: True if this source has authority to validate canonical anatomical facts.

validation_scope.description: Anatomical domains, subdomains, or dimensions this source is permitted to validate.

registered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the source was formally registered.

review_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the source registration.

volume.description: Volume or tomo designation (e.g. 'Tomo 1', 'Volume II'), or null.

original_language.description: Original language of publication if translated, or null.

terminology_standard_version.description: Specific international nomenclature standard adhered to (e.g. 'TA2-2019'), or null.

derived_artifact_id.description: Identifier of a derived technical dataset, if distinct from original source.

derived_from_source_id.description: Canonical source ID from which the derived technical artifact was produced.

derived_artifact_path.description: Path to the derived technical dataset.

derived_artifact_sha256.description: SHA256 checksum of the derived technical dataset.
